host.value: rest.zuora.com and region/sandbox variants listed in swagger servers

object_query_public_url.value: same base URL as v1 REST and v2 for the customer environment (production, sandbox, region); only the path changes (for example /v2/invoices becomes /object-query/invoices; GraphQL is under /object-query/ as well)

entries.url_regex_notes: Matches an optional /v2 prefix, then the path; templated segments match a literal id, ${...}, {...}, %s, or a quoted-concatenation `"+id+"`; trailing path segments or a / after the match are not matched, so /subscriptions does not match /subscriptions/{id} and /subscriptions/{id} does not match .../versions. A trailing slash and the query string are not part of the match. Does not match URLs built from a base-URL variable alone.
